description: A formula \(\varphi(\bar x)\) is preserved downwards between models of \(T\) when, for every embedding \(f:M\hookrightarrow N\) between such models, \(N\models\varphi[f(\bar a)]\) implies \(M\models\varphi[\bar a]\).
